projects.name: Working Memory
projects.detail: Event-sourced task board you can rewind to any past state
projects.tech: Next.js, TypeScript, React, SQLite (better-sqlite3), Litestream, Backblaze B2, Docker, dnd-kit, Tailwind
bullets: Built an append-only, event-sourced task board where every edit, move, and completion is journaled by SQLite triggers, so the board's full state is reconstructable at any past moment, with multi-account isolation enforced at the query layer. Built with AI coding agents under a verification-first workflow: plans before code, a 243-check test suite before release.

Deployed on Render with a self-healing durability pipeline: Litestream streams the database to Backblaze B2 and restores it on every boot (each deploy doubles as a restore drill), backed by daily automated pulls to local storage and an uptime worker that eliminates cold-start churn.

projects.name: armak.tech
projects.detail: Production website for a Southern California low-voltage & networking firm
projects.tech: Vite, EJS, Vanilla JS, HTML Canvas, Web3Forms
bullets: Shipped the live production site for a real contractor: a static Vite + EJS build with hand-written HTML Canvas animations lazy-loaded per viewport, a backend-less Web3Forms lead form, and full Open Graph/SEO metadata — cutting Largest Contentful Paint ~90% with WebP heroes, preload, and fetchpriority.

projects.name: Incighder
projects.detail: Music-scouting tool that scores artist traction and trajectory from public platform metrics
projects.tech: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Python (Flask), TiDB Cloud Serverless (MySQL), Spotify / YouTube Data APIs, SSE, MCP
bullets: Collects artist metrics across seven platforms into per-artist snapshots in TiDB Cloud Serverless, scoring each on a 0–100 Traction index and a separate Trajectory dial from median weekly change — official APIs where they exist, public pages otherwise, throttled per host with a 24h cache.

Registers one 17-tool agent registry that backs both an in-app chat/voice assistant over SSE and an MCP server endpoint, kept live by a self-healing watchdog that health-probes the stack end to end every 20s and auto-restarts and republishes the tunnel — a kill -9 on the tunnel republished in 15s with the site back in 33s.

projects.name: Expert
projects.detail: Personal-knowledge tool that makes everything you've read searchable by content
projects.tech: React, Node.js, Express, JSON store (MySQL optional), MuPDF + Tesseract.js (WASM OCR)
bullets: Captures documents and makes them searchable by content — detecting image-only scans and running a background WASM OCR pipeline (MuPDF page rasterization feeding a pooled Tesseract.js) so even text-less PDFs become searchable — turning a scattered pile of PDFs into one queryable research collection, with cross-source synthesis as the next arc.

projects.name: Ezzy Shop

bullets: Boosted load capacity from 200 to 800 requests/sec and cut server response time from 230ms to 70ms by load-balancing 5 AWS EC2 instances behind Nginx with Redis caching and remedying database-schema bottlenecks.

projects.name: Ableton Library
projects.detail: Local-first catalog of a producer's Ableton projects, searchable by tempo, plugin, sample, or artist
projects.tech: Rust, Tauri, TypeScript, React, SQLite (FTS5), Python
bullets: Streaming-parses gzipped Ableton .als XML straight off disk to index tempo, devices, tracks, and samples across 2,379 sets in 1,586 projects (Live 9.5–11.3.43), so search and a 3D similarity 'galaxy' (shared samples/devices, tempo, artist prior) run with no Live install, via a 6-crate Rust/Tauri 2 workspace over a local SQLite FTS5 index.

Renders per-set audio previews from four prioritized sources — existing bounces on disk, a second Live install driven by macOS UI automation, a planned headless render, and an explicitly-labeled approximate 'sketch' renderer as fallback.
